title: Existence of section-normalized finite coefficient coordinates
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, n≥0 with finite quotient R=O_E/l^(n+1), and T a scheme with hT:IsUnit(l^(n+1) in Γ(T,O_T)). Then CoefficientCoordinates l E n T hT [def-sp-p1-coefficient-coordinates] is nonempty. Its unit and line isomorphisms send every scalar generator and every scalar-times-root generator, on every etale chart and pro-etale refinement, to the prescribed identical scalar and root-tensor sections.

source.place: paragraph (1), finite coefficient identification before the system splitting

proof.text: For the unit, compose realization of the oplax monoidal comparison unit with proEtaleConstantModuleUnit and the actual coefficient evaluation map. Naturality of the associated-module unit, comparison_pure_sections, and the unique regular-module normalization prove unit_sections. The evaluation ring equality acts as the identity on every section.

For the line, compose realization of finiteRootSiteComparison.sigma with the uniquely normalized intrinsic root-tensor isomorphism. Naturality of the realization unit, the sigma pure-tensor equation, and the intrinsic tensor equation prove line_sections.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1); D2 constructs normalized coefficient coordinates and transports adjunctions, allowing the existential inverse-image comparison to be adjusted on the tensor unit
